newsitem.title: PERU: Peru net int'l reserves rise to $8.447 bln Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: Peru net int'l reserves rise to $8.447 bln Nov 13.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Friday its net international reserves rose to $8.447 billion on November 13 from $8.397 billion the week before.
The bank's foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short and long-term debt obligations, was $1.593 billion on the same day.
President Alberto Fujimori said earlier the government expected Peru's international reserves to rise above $10 billion by mid-1998.
